name: The Age of Adventurers
description: The period beginning with World of Warcraft: renewed faction conflict, Ahn'Qiraj, campaigns in Outland and Northrend, the Cataclysm, Pandaria, alternate Draenor, and the Legion's final invasion.

name: Rise of the Ancient Civilizations
description: The trolls and their empires, the aqir wars, the mogu, Pandaria, ancient humans, and the ascent of the kaldorei.

name: Cosmic Origins and the Black Empire
description: Azeroth's immense nascent world-soul left its native elementals without enough Spirit to balance them. Their long conflict was overtaken by the arrival of the Old Gods and the civilization their servants raised across the primordial world.

name: The Long Vigil and the New Kingdoms
description: The night elves guard Kalimdor while Quel'Thalas, Arathor, the Seven Human Kingdoms, Khaz Modan, and other post-Sundering powers develop.

name: The Modern Cosmic Age
description: The Fourth War, N'Zoth's return, Shadowlands, the awakening of the Dragon Isles, and Azeroth's increasingly direct role in the Worldsoul Saga.

name: Ordering of Azeroth
description: The Titan-forged armies defeat and imprison the Old Gods, reshape the planet, create the Well of Eternity, and establish facilities such as Ulduar.

name: The Rise of the Horde and the First Two Wars
description: Draenor's corruption, the orcs' fall to the Legion, opening of the Dark Portal, destruction of Stormwind, and the Alliance victory in the Second War.

name: The Third War and the Frozen Throne
description: The Scourge, Arthas's downfall, destruction of Lordaeron and Quel'Thalas, the Legion's return, the Battle of Mount Hyjal, and the creation of the Lich King's new order.

name: The War of the Ancients and the Sundering
description: Queen Azshara, the Burning Legion's first invasion, the destruction of the Well of Eternity, and the shattering of primordial Kalimdor.

name: Al'Akir
description: The cunning Elemental Lord of air, whose forces relied on spying, division, and sudden storms.

name: Aqir
description: Resilient insectoid servants formed from the Old Gods' organic matter and set to building the empire's cities and temples.

name: Azeroth's World-Soul
description: A titan spirit developing within the young world's core, whose immense growth drew in much of Azeroth's Spirit.

name: The Black Empire
description: The civilization of Old God domains, citadels, and temple cities that spread across primordial Azeroth.

name: The Elemental Hosts
description: The innumerable air, fire, earth, and water spirits led by Azeroth's four Elemental Lords.

name: Neptulon
description: The Elemental Lord of water, portrayed as a patient strategist who struck divided rivals.

name: N'raqi
description: Intelligent servants formed from the Old Gods' organic matter and used as taskmasters within the expanding empire.

name: The Old Gods
description: Void-linked entities that struck Azeroth, spread corruption through the world, and drove tendrils toward its core.

name: Primordial Kalimdor
description: The largest continent of primordial Azeroth, shown here with an interpretive rather than surveyed outline.

name: Ragnaros
description: The Elemental Lord of fire, characterized by direct, destructive force against his rivals.

name: Therazane
description: The Elemental Lord of earth, protective of her children and defended by formidable mountain barriers.

name: Y'Shaarj's Central Bastion
description: An editorial label for the greatest Black Empire bastion, built around Y'Shaarj near the center of Azeroth's largest continent.

name: Y'Shaarj
description: The Old God identified by Chronicle as the greatest of the group, surrounded by the Black Empire's largest bastion.

name: Black Empire Dominion
description: The elementals failed to dislodge the Old Gods and were enslaved; without that resistance, Black Empire influence extended over much of the world.

name: Rise of the Black Empire
description: The n'raqi directed the aqir in building citadels and temple cities around the Old Gods; Y'Shaarj's central bastion became the greatest of these domains as their holdings spread.

name: Arrival of the Old Gods
description: A group of Old Gods struck Azeroth from the Great Dark, embedded themselves in different parts of the world, and extended their influence toward its core.

name: The Primordial Imbalance
description: As Azeroth's world-soul developed, it consumed much of the fifth element, Spirit, leaving the native elementals without its balancing influence.

name: The Elemental Assault on the Black Empire
description: For the first time, Azeroth's rival elemental hosts united against the Old Gods and attacked the Black Empire's growing cities.

name: The Elemental Wars
description: The four Elemental Lords and their hosts fought across primordial Azeroth for ages, with dominion shifting continually and no lasting victor.

name: The Elemental Resistance to the Black Empire
description: A descriptive campaign grouping for the Elemental Lords' united attempt to remove the Old Gods and their growing empire.

name: The Elemental Wars
description: A descriptive campaign grouping for the prolonged struggle among Azeroth's four elemental hosts.
